# Braintree Payments Modular Platform

Braintree offers global commerce payment infrastructure backed by PayPal. Designed for enterprises and digital merchants.

## Interchange Plus Pricing
Pricing starts at 2.59% + $.49 per transaction for cards and digital wallets.

## Enterprise Inquiries
Contact us at sales@braintreepayments.com or visit our headquarters in Chicago, Illinois.

Built for online businesses seeking global scale and payment redundancy.
